ambiguities_or_notes: Both repeated Святочная ночь headings and both plan sequences are represented.
The first plan runs I through XI with deleted items; the second keeps a blank I, the source numbering, deleted VI Reality, restored VI Love, and XII made only of dashes.
увлечение is rendered Infatuation rather than the broader Enthusiasm because it occurs between the ball and innocence/love in a plot plan.
святочная is rendered Christmastide rather than silently narrowing the title to Christmas Day/Night.
The single note stating that VI was altered from VII is translated.
